rule.description: PosixAccount entitlement: do not match existing accounts
rule.comment: When using the PosixAccount entitlement with the Identity Manager user application or Role Based Entitlements, accounts are created and deleted/disabled by granting or revoking the entitlement. Default policy does not match an existing account in NxSettings if the user is not entitled to an account in NxSettings. Modify or remove this rule if you want entitlement policy to apply to matching accounts in NxSettings. Notice that this may result in the NxSettings account being deleted or disabled.
